Index: <tmp>\tmpg_9yvivu\repo\README.md
===================================================================
--- <tmp>\tmpg_9yvivu\repo\README.md
+++ <tmp>\tmpg_9yvivu\repo\README.md
@@ -1,7 +1,14 @@
-An HTTP server that routes each request by the method and target in its request line.
+An HTTP server that parses the request line, headers, and any Content-Length body before routing.
 
 Run: `node server.js`
 
 Minimum Node.js version: 22
 
 Port: 8080
+
+Routes: `GET /`, `GET /users/:userId/posts/:postId`, and `/echo` (any method).
+`/echo` returns the method and path as plain text, for example `POST /echo`.
+Malformed or incomplete requests receive `400 Bad Request`. Chunked request bodies
+are not supported. Connections close after one response.
+
+Test: `npm test`
